descripcion: Collect a postcard from each wall and take them to the curator.

pasos.texto: The postcard of slot 3, on the west wall
The postcard of slot 9, on the north wall
The postcard of slot 17, on the east wall
The postcard of slot 20, on the south wall
Go back to the ticket booth and show your postcards to the curator

textos.aceptada: Four postcards, one per wall: slots 3, 9, 17 and 20.
textos.completada: Your name goes into the book of patrons.
